{"diagnosis": "The 30 duplicate txn_ids are amount corrections: the 2026-01-18 payments-source change says a corrected record repeats the txn_id with record_version incremented, and the profile shows exactly 30 rows at record_version 2. The silver step keeps both versions, so each corrected transaction is counted twice downstream. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id before the POSTED filter removes the superseded rows.",
 "decision": "fix",
 "confidence": 0.72,
 "pre_sql": [],
 "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
